name: Mulethi sticks - 100gms. Improves Kidney, Liver and Bladder functions, May boost immunity, protect against disease and promote liver health
original_description:
Aayurvedaa Mulethi Sticks – 100g are hand-harvested, sun-dried licorice root sticks, traditionally used in Ayurveda for their natural sweetness and soothing qualities. Sourced from premium farms, these sticks are ideal for daily herbal infusion, oral care, or as a gentle, natural flavor enhancer in teas and decoctions.

In Ayurvedic practice, Mulethi (Glycyrrhiza glabra) has long been valued for its calming effect on the throat and its role in supporting natural oral hygiene. Many households enjoy it as a traditional after-meal chew, appreciated for its mild, naturally sweet taste and comforting texture.

Traditional Uses of Mulethi Sticks

  • Gently soothes the throat during seasonal changes
  • Supports natural oral comfort and freshness
  • Used in Ayurvedic preparations to balance taste and enhance herbal synergy
  • A naturally sweet alternative to refined sugars in herbal teas
  • Traditionally consumed as a gentle after-meal aid for digestive comfort
  • Part of age-old rituals for daily wellness routines

Each 100g pack contains 100% pure, chemical-free Mulethi sticks — no additives, no preservatives, no artificial flavors. Perfect for those seeking authentic Ayurvedic ingredients for home-based wellness rituals.

How to Use: Chew a small piece after meals, or simmer in water to make a soothing herbal infusion. Store in a cool, dry place.

For best results, use as part of a balanced lifestyle and mindful routine. Consult an Ayurvedic practitioner for personalized guidance.
